map.单位时间/空间内发生 k 次事件的概率。: Probability of observing k events within a unit of time or space.

map.单位时间/空间事件数：P(X=k)=λ^k·e^−λ/k!。: Event counts per unit of time or space: P(X=k)=λ^k·e^−λ/k!.
map.λ 为平均发生率（均值=方差）。: λ is the average rate (mean = variance).
map.罕见事件计数（呼叫、故障）。: Counts of rare events such as calls or failures.
map.P(X=0)=e^−3≈0.0498，约 5% 概率无人到达。: P(X=0)=e^−3≈0.0498, so there is about a 5% chance nobody arrives.
map.泊松何时近似二项？: When does the Poisson approximate the binomial?
map.n 大、p 小、np=λ 适中时，二项≈泊松，常用于稀有事件建模。: With large n, small p and a moderate np=λ, the binomial is approximately Poisson, the standard model for rare events.
map.能，λ 是平均率（如每小时 2.5 次），不要求整数。: Yes. λ is an average rate (for example 2.5 per hour) and need not be a whole number.
